trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
Going around the edge to (2,5), the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,1); going down, the next 3 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,5). So the line goes up.
Going right would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes around the edge to (5,1).
I can't rule out up or around the edge to (5,5) yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.
I can't rule out up or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.
Going around the edge to (3,5) would leave number 4 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes right.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going right, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,3); going to number 4, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So my guess (up from number 3) was wrong, so the line must go right.
Going up would leave number 4 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going right, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,3). So the line goes down.
Going around the edge to (1,2) would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes right.
The line must go up: around the edge to (1,3) is number 7, which comes later; right is number 9, which comes later.
Going right, the next 4 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at number 6. So the line goes up.
Going right would leave both cell (3,1) and cell (4,5) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes left.
Going left would leave number 7 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes up.
Number 7 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Cell (1,2) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes left.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Cell (4,5) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes down.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
